Surprisingly, PCR performed on An. gambiae adult mosquitoes of the DZOU colony did not show either any known kdr resistance mutation, neither the western (L1014F substitution: N = 31, all susceptible homozygous) nor the eastern (L1014S substitution: N = 28, all susceptible homozygous).
The absence of the ace-1R allele was confirmed by PCR performed on adult mosquitoes from the DZOU original sample (N = 30, all homozygous for ace-1 susceptible alleles).
